title: Contextual IJ capitalization
description_en: When authorized text needs initial capitalization, treat ij as IJ, as in IJsland; do not force every in-word ij to capitals or alter a registered name.
requirement: When authorized text needs initial capitalization, treat ij as IJ, as in IJsland; do not force every in-word ij to capitals or alter a registered name.

title: IJ collation and compatibility forms
description_en: Keep i+j distinct from y for ordinary sorting and keep U+0132/U+0133 source characters intact; ligature appearance is a separate font decision.
requirement: Keep i+j distinct from y for ordinary sorting and keep U+0132/U+0133 source characters intact; ligature appearance is a separate font decision.

title: Emphasis and lexical accents
description_en: Distinguish lexical accents in café or Émile from added emphasis. Keep íj́ combining marks and allow documented technical omission of the j accent without automatic failure.
requirement: Distinguish lexical accents in café or Émile from added emphasis. Keep íj́ combining marks and allow documented technical omission of the j accent without automatic failure.

title: Trema depends on word structure
description_en: Preserve poëzie, coördinatie, reeën and essentiële. Do not substitute a trema for the compound-boundary hyphen in co-ouderschap or gala-avond.
requirement: Preserve poëzie, coördinatie, reeën and essentiële. Do not substitute a trema for the compound-boundary hyphen in co-ouderschap or gala-avond.

title: Compound word boundaries
description_en: Keep langetermijnplanning intact rather than inserting spaces to fit a card; assess optional clarifying hyphens through meaning and house style.
requirement: Keep langetermijnplanning intact rather than inserting spaces to fit a card; assess optional clarifying hyphens through meaning and house style.

title: Compound exceptions
description_en: A4-formaat, IQ-test, top 10, e-mail, lay-out and second opinion follow different constructions; a single English-derived joining rule cannot cover them.
requirement: A4-formaat, IQ-test, top 10, e-mail, lay-out and second opinion follow different constructions; a single English-derived joining rule cannot cover them.

title: Dictionary absence is advisory
description_en: A missing dictionary entry can be a new compound, specialist term or brand. Confirm the authoritative spelling before calling it an error.
requirement: A missing dictionary entry can be a new compound, specialist term or brand. Confirm the authoritative spelling before calling it an error.

title: Apostrophe roles
description_en: Distinguish plural, possession, abbreviation and elision in risico's, cafés, oma's, Agnes', sms'en and AOW'er; exclude code and stable identifiers from typography edits.
requirement: Distinguish plural, possession, abbreviation and elision in risico's, cafés, oma's, Agnes', sms'en and AOW'er; exclude code and stable identifiers from typography edits.

title: Sentence-initial elision
description_en: Preserve the apostrophe role and capitalized full word in 's Morgens; a smart-quote pass must not turn it into an opening quotation.
requirement: Preserve the apostrophe role and capitalized full word in 's Morgens; a smart-quote pass must not turn it into an opening quotation.

title: Registered personal names
description_en: Keep Anna van den Bos and Anna Van den Bossche as supplied. Do not infer nationality or silently normalize surname particles from presumed region.
requirement: Keep Anna van den Bos and Anna Van den Bossche as supplied. Do not infer nationality or silently normalize surname particles from presumed region.

title: Quotation hierarchy
description_en: Select a house quotation and nesting style; sentence punctuation depends on complete versus partial quotations and the cited source.
requirement: Select a house quotation and nesting style; sentence punctuation depends on complete versus partial quotations and the cited source.

title: Punctuation semantics
description_en: Spacing guidance must exempt decimals, abbreviations, code and URLs. Keep hyphens, ranges, minus signs and parenthetical dashes distinct.
requirement: Spacing guidance must exempt decimals, abbreviations, code and URLs. Keep hyphens, ranges, minus signs and parenthetical dashes distinct.

title: Contextual hyphenation
description_en: Dutch line-end forms can change spelling. Verify beëindigen→be-/eindigen, parapluutje→paraplu-/tje and cafeetje→café-/tje only in a capable target engine; preserve unbroken source.
requirement: Dutch line-end forms can change spelling. Verify beëindigen→be-/eindigen, parapluutje→paraplu-/tje and cafeetje→café-/tje only in a capable target engine; preserve unbroken source.

title: Meaning-dependent boundaries
description_en: balletje can have different valid splits depending on meaning; do not advertise a unique answer without context. Dictionary middle dots are notation, not manuscript insertions.
requirement: balletje can have different valid splits depending on meaning; do not advertise a unique answer without context. Dictionary middle dots are notation, not manuscript insertions.

title: Conditional hyphenation support
description_en: Check the installed nl dictionary, language declaration, real width and copy/search results; hyphens:auto or a soft hyphen alone does not prove correct behavior.
requirement: Check the installed nl dictionary, language declaration, real width and copy/search results; hyphens:auto or a soft hyphen alone does not prove correct behavior.

title: Amount and identifier semantics
description_en: Preserve € 5,00, € 5,– and €5-biljet as distinct roles. Apply a declared style to typed amounts rather than globally changing separators or spacing.
requirement: Preserve € 5,00, € 5,– and €5-biljet as distinct roles. Apply a declared style to typed amounts rather than globally changing separators or spacing.

title: NL and BE formatter contexts
description_en: Keep nl-NL and nl-BE separate, recording runtime version and exact spacing codepoints for number, currency and date output; do not treat every difference as an error.
requirement: Keep nl-NL and nl-BE separate, recording runtime version and exact spacing codepoints for number, currency and date output; do not treat every difference as an error.

title: Inclusive date meaning
description_en: Clarify whether tot includes the end date and preserve explicit tot en met. Typography must not silently decide an ambiguous deadline.
requirement: Clarify whether tot includes the end date and preserve explicit tot en met. Typography must not silently decide an ambiguous deadline.

title: Document output checks
description_en: Reopen exported documents and inspect PDF visual layout, selected text, Unicode extraction and font substitution separately; source checks are not Office acceptance.
requirement: Reopen exported documents and inspect PDF visual layout, selected text, Unicode extraction and font substitution separately; source checks are not Office acceptance.

title: Fonts selected by task
description_en: Assess required glyphs, IJ design, combining marks, styles, fallback and licensing for the actual file and medium; Dutch provenance is not a functional requirement.
requirement: Assess required glyphs, IJ design, combining marks, styles, fallback and licensing for the actual file and medium; Dutch provenance is not a functional requirement.

title: Purpose-specific scale
description_en: Use reading, display or hybrid goals and actual distance to choose type hierarchy; trial values are not a universal Dutch point-size standard.
requirement: Use reading, display or hybrid goals and actual distance to choose type hierarchy; trial values are not a universal Dutch point-size standard.

title: Address policy
description_en: Review je/u and possessive forms in context. Region alone does not determine address; quotations, generic je and emphatic jouw can be legitimate exceptions.
requirement: Review je/u and possessive forms in context. Region alone does not determine address; quotations, generic je and emphatic jouw can be legitimate exceptions.

title: Clarity beyond a label
description_en: Assess the reader's task, action, recovery and necessary conditions. A B1 label or shorter sentence does not by itself prove clarity or permit omitted meaning.
requirement: Assess the reader's task, action, recovery and necessary conditions. A B1 label or shorter sentence does not by itself prove clarity or permit omitted meaning.

title: Regional and branded voice
description_en: Preserve nl-BE bankkaart/lidkaart, foreign titles, lowercase brands and approved display breaks. Avoid replacing them with nl-NL vocabulary or applying graphic exceptions to body text.
requirement: Preserve nl-BE bankkaart/lidkaart, foreign titles, lowercase brands and approved display breaks. Avoid replacing them with nl-NL vocabulary or applying graphic exceptions to body text.
